summary: The concept is coherent enough for controlled validation, but it is not signature-, import-, lease-, or launch-ready until the flagged legal, tax, banking, customs, certification, and operational gaps are closed.
confirmed_facts: A partner or company profile was supplied.
A product or project description was supplied.
The decision is at pre signature stage.
The caller has already named open blockers on the file.
assumptions: Public cost benchmarks are not signed quotes.
Supplier prices are not Kazakhstan landed costs.
Representative-office, branch, LLP, distributor, importer, and dealer models require local legal review.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Written recommendation on branch, representative office, LLP, distributor, importer, or dealer structure.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The legal form affects sales, import, service, tax, contracting, and liability.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Current registry extract for the partner and any local counterparty (status, directors, address).
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: A live registry extract confirms the counterparty exists and who can bind it before any contract.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Pull a fresh registry extract for each named counterparty.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Beneficial-ownership record showing who ultimately owns and controls the counterparty.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Ownership drives integrity, sanctions, and conflict exposure; an unknown UBO is an unmanaged risk.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Obtain a UBO declaration or registry source for each counterparty.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Integrity / anti-corruption due diligence on the distributor, agents, and any government-facing intermediaries (ownership, embedded officials, adverse media, sanctions and PEP screening).
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Under FCPA / UK Bribery Act the foreign parent can be liable for an intermediary's conduct; engaging a partner who touches customs, certification, or akimat without integrity DD is an unmanaged exposure.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Run integrity DD before appointing or contracting any local partner or agent.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Bank-account opening readiness: full UBO pack (apostilled), source-of-funds and expected-turnover statement, and the presence / timeline the chosen bank requires.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Account opening for a foreign-owned entity is document-heavy and slow; until it clears, the entity cannot pay suppliers or receive revenue.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Confirm the bank's KYC checklist and start onboarding in parallel with entity setup.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Evidence the entry vehicle has real substance (office, staff, local decision-making) appropriate to the chosen model.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Thin substance undermines tax treatment, banking onboarding, and counterparty trust.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Document the planned substance for the chosen entry model.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Evidence that the individual signing for each counterparty has authority to bind it.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: A contract signed without authority is unenforceable and a fraud vector.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Collect powers of attorney or board authorizations for the signatories.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Draft contract or term sheet covering scope, pricing, territory, exclusivity, term, and exit.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Commercial terms must be on paper before signature so they can be reviewed and negotiated.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Produce a term sheet or draft contract for review.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Note on VAT, corporate tax, withholding, and accounting treatment for the chosen entry model.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Tax and accounting treatment change the real cost and reporting load of the entry model.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request a tax and accounting memo for each candidate entry model.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Assessment of whether the chosen entry model (branch, representative office, LLP, or direct contracting) creates a taxable permanent establishment or resident status.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Permanent-establishment and residency treatment drive tax registration, reporting load, and the real cost of the entry model.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request a permanent-establishment and tax-residency memo for each candidate entry model.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Note on currency-contract registration (mandatory at the USD 50,000 threshold for legal entities under the 2026 currency-control rules), repatriation reporting, and how supplier payments, intercompany flows, and profit repatriation will clear local banks.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Under the 2026 currency-control regime local banks can delay or refuse cross-border intercompany transfers (capital, shareholder loans, royalties, management fees) that lack demonstrable economic substance, so substance evidence affects how, and how quickly, money moves after commitment.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Confirm currency-contract registration at the USD 50,000 threshold and prepare economic-substance evidence for intercompany flows with the servicing bank.
evidence_gaps.decision_blocked: Cross-border payment, intercompany-flow, and profit-repatriation planning.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Note on work-permit requirements and local-employment ratio / quota obligations for the planned expatriate and local headcount.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Foreign-worker quotas and local-employment ratios constrain who can be deployed and when.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Confirm work-permit and local-employment quota requirements for the staffing plan.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Supply the certification pathway for this market-entry file.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The certification pathway is a required gate input that is not yet in the evidence pack.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request or produce the certification pathway.
evidence_gaps.decision_blocked: Progression to the next market-entry commitment.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Supply the service partner confirmation for this market-entry file.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The service partner confirmation is a required gate input that is not yet in the evidence pack.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request or produce the service partner confirmation.
evidence_gaps.decision_blocked: Progression to the next market-entry commitment.

evidence_gaps.evidence_needed: Supply the spare parts price list for this market-entry file.
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The spare parts price list is a required gate input that is not yet in the evidence pack.
evidence_gaps.next_action: Request or produce the spare parts price list.
evidence_gaps.decision_blocked: Progression to the next market-entry commitment.

claim_audit.claim: The project can move into controlled validation.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Use for advisor requests, quotes, and structured partner or customer interviews.

claim_audit.claim: The project is ready for launch commitment.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Do not use. Replace with the current readiness label until the evidence gaps are closed.

claim_audit.claim: The blockers the caller named on this file are resolved.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Do not treat as resolved: the caller listed 12 open blocker(s) (e.g. "No law-firm opinion supplied."). Close each one and re-run the gate.

claim_audit.claim: The caller-supplied cost, price, and structure assumptions are decision-grade.
claim_audit.how_to_use_now: Treat the caller's assumptions as planning inputs only; confirm with signed quotes, landed-cost models, and local legal / tax review before any commitment.

owner_actions.action: Send the missing-evidence request to the partner and named advisors.
Collect the legal, tax, banking, customs, certification, and operational inputs the gate flagged.
Convert the validation evidence into a committee-ready entry decision memo.

watch_next: bank KYC or account-opening tightening for foreign-owned entities
anti-corruption enforcement or third-party due-diligence expectation change
boundary_notice: Internal evidence triage only. Not legal, compliance, customs, tax, financial, investment, insurance, sanctions, or launch-authorization advice.
strongest_reason_to_proceed: The Kazakhstan use case and commercial objective are specific enough to start advisor requests, quote collection, and partner validation.
strongest_reason_to_pause: The current evidence pack is not sufficient for signature, import, lease, first-batch order, advertising spend, or partner appointment.
management_note: The opportunity can move at the level of its readiness label, but should not move to launch commitment until the flagged legal, customs, certification, landed-cost, service, lease, and partner evidence gaps are closed.
